INJECTION_GUARD_ENABLED.graduation_criterion: 30/30 fully-live golden cases complete with prompt-injection success count = 0 and no reader-visible metric regression

LLM_TOOL_SELECTION_ENABLED.graduation_criterion: 30/30 fully-live cases complete and gold numeric fact recall improves by >= 0.10 beyond the paired noise floor

MCP_CLIENT_ENABLED.graduation_criterion: 3/3 configured external MCP server probes discover, register and execute a tool with budget and trajectory records present

PRIOR_MEMORY_ENABLED.graduation_criterion: 30/30 paired second-run cases read prior snapshots and improve reader-visible gold fact recall by >= 0.05 beyond noise

PROCEDURAL_MEMORY_ENABLED.graduation_criterion: 30/30 paired second-run cases read learned procedures and reduce failed behavioral criteria by >= 20% beyond noise

RAG_ENABLED.graduation_criterion: 30/30 fully-live cases have evidence_reachable_rate >= 0.60 with disclosure lookahead violations = 0

REFLECTION_ENABLED.graduation_criterion: 30/30 paired fully-live cases reduce failed behavioral criteria by >= 20% beyond the paired noise floor

RESEARCH_LOOP_ENABLED.graduation_criterion: 30/30 paired fully-live cases improve gold numeric fact recall by >= 0.10 beyond noise without increasing orphaned_sub_questions

SKILL_PACKS_ENABLED.graduation_criterion: 30/30 paired finance cases use at least 1 located skill pack and improve metric-normalization errors by >= 20% beyond noise
